newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to release 500 bln won through repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to release 500 bln won through repos.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea would release 500 billion won into the banking system for two days from Monday through repurchase agreements (repos), a central bank official said.
The official said the central bank decided to supply the money to the banking system to help stabilise market sentiment.
"As far as I know, the money market has no problem with its demand and supply. Given unstable market sentiment, the bank decided to release the money," he said.
